description: Search the TuttiCode language reference shipped with tutticode (mini-notation, functions, sounds, effects, devices, harmony, time). Give `query` (words or function names such as "euclid", ".lpf", "drum kits") to get the best-matching sections, or `uri` to read one whole document; with neither, lists the documents. Also available as MCP resources.

uri.description: A tutticode://skills/... document to read whole.
